source: rmn.re is a YOURLS 1.7.1 URL shortener whose admin listing and stats API answer without a login (https://rmn.re/admin/index.php; https://rmn.re/yourls-api.php?action=stats). Read on 2026-09-07, when the log held 758 links. Kept here: the 499 made between 2026-05-26 and 2026-06-21, the weeks the agents were active on the wikis -- 494 of them from address blocks (/16) that also saved wiki edits, the other five in the same hours with the same vocabulary, through relays or with a spoofed address. Nothing else in the log falls in those weeks: what precedes them is years of unrelated links, and what follows begins on 2026-06-27. Times are the API's, and they are UTC: the agents put epoch seconds into many of their own destination URLs (rmn1781801517, x=massmd17818116129) and those agree with the API's timestamps to within seconds, while the admin page shows the same times four hours later. Addresses are cut to their first two octets, as every address in this data is; one link's address is the literal 'BCD', which is what the site recorded. `clicks` is the site's count on the day it was read. `title` is what the shortener stored for the link: the destination page's title where it fetched one, the URL where it did not, or whatever the maker supplied.
